title: Storage Cleaner: Free Up Space
summary: Phone storage cleaner & duplicate photo remover. Free up space, compress videos
description:
Storage Cleaner is a phone storage cleaner for Android that helps you free up space and keep your device running smoothly. Scan your phone storage for duplicate photos, large videos, old screenshots, and files taking up unnecessary space. Whether you need to free up space to install new apps or want a cleaner phone, this storage cleaning app has you covered.

SWIPE TO DELETE PHOTOS
A photo cleaner with swipe to delete built in. Swipe to delete photos you no longer need — swipe left to delete, swipe right to keep. This photo cleaner swipe feature lets you sort through hundreds of photos in minutes. Works with photos, screenshots, and videos — the easiest photo cleaner app for everyday phone storage cleanup.

DUPLICATE PHOTO REMOVER
The duplicate photo remover scans your gallery to find exact duplicate photos using image fingerprinting. Duplicates are grouped so you can compare them side by side. The app suggests which copy to keep based on quality and size, making it simple to remove storage space taken up by unnecessary copies.

DUPLICATE FILE REMOVER & DUPLICATE CLEANER
Beyond photos, the duplicate file remover detects duplicate screenshots, duplicate videos, and duplicate documents including PDFs and spreadsheets. This duplicate cleaner works as a complete duplicate files fixer — scanning your phone storage to find every redundant copy. Select all duplicates with one tap and delete them to free up storage instantly.

VIDEO COMPRESSOR FOR ANDROID
The built-in video compressor for Android lets you video compress large files to a fraction of their size. Choose from three compression levels depending on how much space you need. This video compressor app also compresses photos and documents. A single video compress can save hundreds of megabytes, making the video compressor one of the most effective tools in this storage cleaner free up space app.

EMAIL CLEANER FOR GMAIL FREE
Connect your Gmail account with the email cleaner for Gmail free feature. Emails are sorted into categories: spam, promotions, social, updates, and forums. Bulk delete what you no longer need. This email cleaner free feature helps reclaim space from thousands of old emails. The email cleaner connects securely through Google Sign-In.

CONTACTS CLEANER APP
The contacts cleaner app finds duplicate contacts saved under the same name or phone number and detects empty contacts. Contacts cleanup has never been easier — review contacts clone entries, merge what you need, and delete the rest. Keep your contacts clean and organized with the built-in contacts cleaner.

HIDE PHOTOS AND VIDEOS APP
Need to hide photos and videos from your gallery? The hide photos app moves private files into a secure vault protected by PIN. Hide photos and videos including screenshots and documents. The vault auto-locks when you leave the app. This hide photos and videos app gives you control over which media stays private.

STORAGE ANALYSIS & STORAGE REMOVER
See a breakdown of your phone storage with the storage analysis tool. The storage remover identifies the largest files so you know what to clean first. Use the home screen widget to monitor phone storage at a glance. Storage removal of unnecessary files is just a tap away with this storage remove app.

FREE UP SPACE ON YOUR ANDROID
This clean up app helps you free up space on your Android in minutes. Free up space storage by removing duplicates, compressing videos, cleaning emails, and organizing contacts. This storage cleaner free tool is a complete cleaner for Android — a phone storage cleaner for Android that handles phone storage cleanup from every angle. Remove storage space used by junk and free up space storage for what matters.

Download Storage Cleaner and free up space today.
